_note: 學習路徑內容建置第18批 #6／6：連接詞 vs 介系詞辨析（eng.t_adv.conj.conj-vs-prep，學測級／高階）。because／although 是連接詞，後接完整子句（主詞＋動詞）；because of／despite／in spite of 是介系詞（片語），後接名詞或動名詞，不接子句。because + 子句 ↔ because of + 名詞 同義不同結構；although + 子句 ↔ despite/in spite of + 名詞/-ing。誘答以『連接詞接名詞／介系詞接子句／despite of 這個常見錯誤／語意相反』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix cvp_）。

units.title_zh: 連接詞 vs 介系詞（because/because of；although/despite）
units.can_do: 我能分辨連接詞（because/although 接子句）與介系詞片語（because of/despite/in spite of 接名詞或動名詞），並正確選用；也知道 despite 沒有 despite of。
units.situation_group: 連接詞 vs 介系詞辨析
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Conjunctions like 'because' and 'although' are followed by a clause (subject + verb): 'because it was raining', 'although she was tired'.
claims.verification_ref: 連接詞 because/although 後接子句（主詞＋動詞）；because it was raining；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Prepositions like 'because of', 'despite' and 'in spite of' are followed by a noun or -ing form, not a full clause: 'because of the rain', 'despite the noise'. There is no 'despite of'.
claims.verification_ref: 介系詞 because of/despite/in spite of 後接名詞或 -ing、不接子句；沒有 despite of；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'because' + clause and 'because of' + noun have the same meaning but different structure: 'We stayed home because it rained / because of the rain.'
claims.verification_ref: because + 子句 與 because of + 名詞 同義不同結構；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'although' + clause vs 'despite / in spite of' + noun or -ing: 'Although he was ill, he worked = Despite being ill, he worked.'
claims.verification_ref: although + 子句 ↔ despite/in spite of + 名詞或 -ing；Although he was ill = Despite being ill；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: because and although are conjunctions: they are followed by a full clause (with a subject and a verb). because of and despite / in spite of are prepositions (phrases): they are followed only by a noun or an -ing form, not by a full clause.
teach.zh_hint: because 和 although 是「連接詞」，後面接一個完整的子句（有主詞和動詞）。because of 和 despite／in spite of 是「介系詞（片語）」，後面只接名詞或動名詞，不接完整子句。

teach.body: We stayed home because it was raining.
teach.zh_hint: 因為在下雨，我們待在家。because + 子句 it was raining。

teach.body: To say the same idea with because of, use only a noun after it: We stayed home because of the rain. (because of + the noun 'the rain'.) Never write 'because of it was raining'.
teach.zh_hint: 同樣的意思換成 because of 時，後面只接名詞：We stayed home because of the rain.（因為下雨，我們待在家；because of＋名詞 the rain。）千萬不要寫 because of it was raining。

teach.body: We stayed home because of the heavy rain.
teach.zh_hint: 因為大雨，我們待在家。because of + 名詞。

teach.body: although (a conjunction) takes a clause; despite / in spite of (prepositions) take a noun or an -ing form. Although he was tired, he kept working. = Despite being tired, he kept working. Note that 'despite of' is not correct English.
teach.zh_hint: although（連接詞）接子句；despite／in spite of（介系詞）接名詞或動名詞。Although he was tired, he kept working. ＝ Despite being tired, he kept working.（雖然他很累，還是繼續工作。）注意沒有 despite of 這種說法。

teach.body: Despite the rain, we went out.
teach.zh_hint: 儘管下雨，我們還是出門了。despite + 名詞 the rain。

practice.stem: 選正確：The game was canceled ____ the storm.（因為暴風雨，比賽取消了）

distractor_rationales.because: because 後面要接子句（主詞＋動詞），但這裡後面是名詞 the storm，要用 because of。
distractor_rationales.although: although 表『雖然』且要接子句，語意和結構都不合。
distractor_rationales.despite of: 沒有 despite of 這種說法（正確是 despite 或 in spite of），而且語意是『儘管』也不合。

practice.feedback: because of + 名詞：because of the storm。

practice.stem: 選正確：We were late ____ the traffic was terrible.（因為交通很糟，我們遲到了）

distractor_rationales.because of: because of 後面接名詞，但這裡後面是完整子句 the traffic was terrible，要用 because。
distractor_rationales.despite: despite 表『儘管』、語意相反，而且後面接名詞不接子句。
distractor_rationales.in spite of: in spite of 接名詞且意思是『儘管』，結構和語意都不合。

practice.feedback: because + 子句：because the traffic was terrible。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ it was raining, we went for a walk.（雖然在下雨，我們還是去散步）

distractor_rationales.Despite: despite 後面接名詞或動名詞，但這裡後面是子句 it was raining，要用 although。
distractor_rationales.In spite of: in spite of 同樣接名詞、不接子句。
distractor_rationales.Because of: because of 表『因為』，語意不合，而且接名詞不接子句。

practice.feedback: although + 子句：Although it was raining…。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ the heavy traffic, she arrived on time.（儘管交通擁擠，她還是準時到了）

distractor_rationales.Although: although 後面接子句，但這裡後面是名詞 the heavy traffic，要用 despite。
distractor_rationales.Because: because 表『因為』、語意不合，而且後面接子句。
distractor_rationales.Despite of: 沒有 despite of 這種說法，正確是 despite 或 in spite of。

practice.feedback: despite + 名詞：Despite the heavy traffic…。

practice.answer: Despite being tired, he finished the race.
options: Despite being tired, he finished the race.
Despite he was tired, he finished the race.
Although being tired, he finished the race.
Because of he was tired, he finished the race.

distractor_rationales.Despite he was tired, he finished the ra: despite 後面接名詞或動名詞，不接子句（he was tired 是子句）。
distractor_rationales.Although being tired, he finished the ra: although 這裡最自然是接完整子句 Although he was tired；'Although being tired' 很不道地，仍以 Despite being tired 為正解。
distractor_rationales.Because of he was tired, he finished the: because of 後面接名詞不接子句，而且語意『因為』也不合。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We went out despite the rain.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：despite + 名詞 the rain（不是 despite of）、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。because of／despite 後接名詞連讀，讓步句前半稍停，句尾下收。

lines.text: We stayed inside because of the cold.
lines.intonation: because of the cold 連讀、句尾 cold 下收

lines.text: Although it was late, they kept talking.
lines.intonation: 前半 Although it was late 稍停、句尾 talking 下收
